testFindings: Guided Next selected 30× and then let real time flow after submission, so by the next UI click the app had correctly advanced beyond38 seconds. Pause the virtual clock while testing exact manual steps.
A prior helper selector edit had accidentally scoped the Team Resume button to a form; restore the Team button selector. Neither failure required an application change.

runs.resolved: Exact manual Next boundaries use a paused virtual clock, so 30× playback cannot run ahead between UI clicks. Team Resume targets the actual Team button. No application changes were needed.

independentHistoryEvidence.note: Actual browser downloads and print PDF; source records are authored operating history.

boundaries: Virtual elapsed duration is not physical endurance or memory profiling.
These workflow checks exercise the operational SVG fallback; actual WebGL and performance are separate evidence.
No operational state or decisions are injected; existing corrupt-storage recovery deliberately supplies malformed JSON only.

finalCombinedCoverage.explanation: This is combined coverage, not a claim that a single complete run passed19. The17 passing frozen-source cases were retained and the two corrected test cases rerun on unchanged application source.
